name: Produktly
desc: Onboarding, in-app announcements, feedback collection and NPS for SaaS products.

actions.name: list_changelogs
actions.description: List all changelogs in your Produktly account.

actions.name: list_changelog_posts
actions.description: List all posts within a specific changelog.

actions.name: create_changelog_post
actions.description: Publish a new post inside a changelog. Visible to your users once active.

actions.name: update_changelog_post
actions.description: Edit an existing changelog post — change its title, body, tags or visibility.

actions.name: list_feedback_widgets
actions.description: List all feedback widgets configured in your Produktly account.

actions.name: list_feedback_responses
actions.description: List the user responses submitted through a feedback widget.

actions.name: list_roadmaps
actions.description: List all public roadmaps in your Produktly account.

actions.name: get_roadmap
actions.description: Get a single roadmap with its sections, items, tags and vote counts.

actions.name: list_nps_widgets
actions.description: List all NPS widgets configured in your Produktly account.

actions.name: get_nps_score
actions.description: Get the current Net Promoter Score (NPS) for a widget, broken down into promoters, passives and detractors.

actions.name: list_nps_responses
actions.description: List individual NPS responses (rating + comment + user info) for a widget.

actions.name: list_tags
actions.description: List all tags that can be attached to changelog posts.

actions.name: get_company_stats
actions.description: Get a company-wide statistics summary across all your Produktly features.

actions.name: get_widget_stats
actions.description: Get event and unique-user statistics for a specific entity type (e.g. all changelogs, all NPS widgets).

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_changelog_post
triggers.description: Fires when a new post is published in the selected changelog.

triggers.name: new_feedback_response
triggers.description: Fires when a user submits a new response to the selected feedback widget.

triggers.name: new_nps_response
triggers.description: Fires when a user submits a new NPS rating for the selected widget.

triggers.name: new_tag
triggers.description: Fires when a new tag is created in your Produktly account.
